## Executive Summary

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(cf.build_narrative(period))
```

## Headline KPIs

```{python}
#| output: asis
kpis = cf.shape_kpis(period)
cards = "".join(
    f'<div class="kpi"><div class="label">{k.label}</div>'
    f'<div class="value">{k.value}</div>'
    f'<div class="kpi-sub">{k.sub}</div></div>'
    for k in kpis
)
print(f'<div class="kpi-strip">{cards}</div>')
```

## Revenue & EBITDA Trend

Trailing `{python} cf.TRAILING_QUARTERS` quarters ending `{python} period`.

```{python}
#| echo: true
df = cf.shape_revenue_trend(period)
fig = REGISTRY["timeseries_multi"].build(df, y_title="$M", metric_name="")
fig
```

## Operating Expense by Category

```{python}
#| echo: true
df = cf.shape_opex_breakdown(period)
fig = REGISTRY["grouped_stacked_bar"].build(df, mode="stacked", y_title="$M")
fig
```

## Revenue by Segment

```{python}
#| echo: true
df = cf.shape_segment_mix(period)
fig = REGISTRY["treemap"].build(df, value_title="$M", root_label=f"{period} Revenue")
fig
```

## Budget vs. Actual Bridge

```{python}
#| echo: true
df = cf.shape_budget_bridge(period)
fig = REGISTRY["waterfall"].build(df, mode="variance", y_title="$M")
fig
```

## Margin Trend

```{python}
#| echo: true
df = cf.shape_margin_heatmap(period)

fig
```
